pieces.Text: If you have performed your daily obedience, you can ensure the final rest of a creature. As a standard action, you can touch a corpse and cause it to dissolve into black ash. A corpse dissolved this way cannot be raised as an undead creature by any means short of a miracle or wish. The black ash left behind can, however, be used as the "corpse" for spells that return the dead to true life-such as raise dead-as long as the entire collection of ash is kept together.
